summary: RUN_URL checks that `run` is a github.com URL of some repository with some path, not that it is a workflow run of this repository. An issue or pull request link passes and is rendered as 'see the run'. The commit SHA check is exact and is the decoy.
origin: a real miss: a link validated by its shape accepted an issue URL where a run URL was required

must_not_find.why: COMMIT_SHA is anchored and exact: forty lowercase hex characters, nothing else. Flagging it means the reviewer judged both regexes by their appearance. No keyword is a string of the diff.
